newsitem.title: USA: Wilmington, N.C., authority approves housing bonds.
newsitem.headline: Wilmington, N.C., authority approves housing bonds.

text.p: North Carolina's Wilmington Housing Authority has agreed to issue $12.05 million of revenue bonds for the Antigua Pointe housing development to be built by Hawthorne Ltd, the Wilmington Star-News said Wednesday.

The tax-exempt bonds are to be sold on the private market. The authority said the likely buyer is Sun America, a California insurance company that has worked with Hawthorne on housing developments ins six other states.
The proposal calls for Hawthorne to build 224 rental units for elderly residents, with at least 20 percent priced within reach of low-income people.
The Wilmington City Council approved the site selection in September but still must sign off on the bond issue, the newspaper said.
